div.head: I Cn 4
div.ab: Eallum Cristenum mannum gebyrað swiþe rihte, þæt hig haligdom ⁊ hadas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hus æfre swiþe georne griðian ⁊ friðian, ⁊ þæt hi hada gewhylcne weorðian be mæðe.
Eallum Cristenum mannum gebyrað swyðe rihte, þæt hig halidom ⁊ hadas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hus æfre swyðe georne griðian ⁊ fryðian, ⁊ þæt hy hada gehwylcne weorðian be mæðe.
Christianis omnibus sincere conuenit sanctuaria et ordines et Deo dicata loca summa discretione, tota deuotione pacificare, custodire, uenerari iuxta modum singulorum.
Eallum Cristenum mannum gebyrað swiþe rihte, þæt hig haligdom ⁊ hadas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hus æfre swiþe georne griðian ⁊ friðian, ⁊ þæt hi hada gehwylcne weorðian be mæðe.

It very justly befits all Christian men to maintain very zealously at all times the security and sanctity of holy things and of the members of the clergy, and of the consecrated houses of God, and to honour each member of the clergy according to his rank.

Allen Christenmenschen geziemt sehr gehörig, dass sie Heiligthum und Geistliche und geweihte Gotteshäuser stets recht eifrig mit Sonderschutz befrieden, und dass sie jeden der [Klerus]stände nach dessen Range ehren.

It very rightly befits all Christian people always to protect and keep the peace of relics and men in orders and consecrated houses of God most eagerly, and to honour each order according to its rank.
